title: Build Different
subtitle: How to get better at Fortnite
version_note: Written in Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), October 2026. The skills in this book work in any season.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book about getting better: settings, landing, listening, aiming, building, Zero Build movement, the storm, teamwork, practice and keeping your cool.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. Pick one a day and use it at dinner. Extra points if nobody notices it came from a Fortnite book.

chapters.title: Before You Drop
chapters.label: Start here
chapters.dek: Nobody is born good at Fortnite. Here's how this book turns practice into wins.

chapters.title: Know Your Bars
chapters.dek: Two bars, three colours and one storm. The numbers every good player knows by heart.

chapters.title: Settings Sorted
chapters.dek: Ten minutes in the menu can win you more fights than ten hours of playing. Here's what to switch on.

chapters.title: The First Sixty Seconds
chapters.dek: Most matches are won or lost before your feet touch the grass. How to drop fast, land first and loot like lightning.

chapters.title: Ears Wide Open
chapters.dek: The best players know where you are before they can see you. Here's how they do it.

chapters.title: Point and Chug
chapters.dek: Where to keep your crosshair, when to stand still, and why the first shot matters most.

chapters.title: Pick Your Fights
chapters.toc: When to fight, when to run
chapters.dek: Winning a fight is good. Choosing the right fight is better. A flowchart, a warning about third parties, and the art of the getaway.

chapters.title: Brick by Brick
chapters.dek: Four pieces, three materials, and the moves that every builder learns first.

chapters.title: Zero Build Hero
chapters.dek: No walls? No problem. Sliding, mantling, wall kicks and the art of hiding behind a very large rock.

chapters.title: Storm Chasers
chapters.toc: The storm and how to move
chapters.dek: The storm is the one enemy you can't eliminate. How it works, and how to stay one step ahead of it.

chapters.title: Squad Goals
chapters.dek: Four average players who work together will beat four brilliant players who don't. Here's how to be the teammate everyone wants.

chapters.title: The Final Circle
chapters.dek: Ten players left, a tiny circle and your heart thumping. How to stay calm and finish the job.

chapters.title: Training Montage
chapters.toc: How to practise, and how Ranked works
chapters.dek: Playing lots of matches isn't the same as practising. A weekly plan, replays, and how Ranked really works.

chapters.title: Keep Your Cool
chapters.dek: The secret skill every champion has, and it's got nothing to do with aiming.

chapters.title: Myth or Fact?
chapters.dek: Do skins make you better? Is higher sensitivity always faster? We check the things everybody says.

chapters.title: The Build Different Quiz
chapters.label: Back of the book
chapters.dek: Fifteen questions. One Chug Jug for each right answer.
